name: owner_truth_product_session_isolation
summary: Materializes product-session identity for active interview sessions, preserving one natural-input session while isolating Live reconnect and new sessions.
operations: add nullable bounded product_session_id to conversation_threads and interview_sessions
backfill product_session_id from existing metadata without rewriting history
replace one-active-per-vault index with natural-input and product-session scoped unique indexes
rollback: No automatic destructive rollback. Restore the former single-active index only after all active product-scoped sessions have been ended or reconciled in an isolated recovery run.
